input.quote: IN NO EVENT SHALL TRUELINK'S LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO SECTION 3, 4, 7 AND 11 THIS AGREEMENT (OTHER THAN DUE TO A BREACH RESULTING FROM TRUELINK'S GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT) EXCEED THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTHS PERIOD.
input.rationale: The only liability limitation in the Agreement (p0077, buried at the end of the indemnity section) is one-sided: it caps TrueLink alone at 12 months' hosting/support compensation, while Client's liability — including the very broad indemnity in Section 12(a) covering any breach, any Client Content claim and product/service injury claims — is entirely uncapped. That is squarely in the rule's walk-away territory ("Customer's liability uncapped while Vendor's is capped"), so it fails the fallback, which requires a mutual 12-month fees cap. The clause is also narrowed to "Section 3, 4, 7 and 11", none of which appear as headings in the document, making even the vendor-side cap of uncertain scope; there is no exclusion of indirect or consequential damages anywhere in the Agreement, and no carve-out structure beyond gross negligence/wilful misconduct on TrueLink's side only. Redline makes the cap mutual and Agreement-wide at the greater of 12 months' compensation and USD 1,000,000, excludes indirect damages, and places indemnification, confidentiality/data security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement outside the cap; Client's payment obligations are preserved outside the limitation. A straight mutual 12 months' fees cap with indemnity/confidentiality/gross negligence carve-outs is the acceptable fallback.

proposal.summary: Make the liability cap mutual, extend it to the whole Agreement, add a meaningful floor, exclude indirect damages, and place indemnities/confidentiality outside the cap.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We made the cap mutual and applicable to the whole Agreement rather than only Sections 3, 4, 7 and 11, since as drafted TrueLink is capped while our liability (including the broad Section 12(a) indemnity) is unlimited. Our position is a mutual cap at the greater of 12 months' fees and USD 1,000,000, with indemnification, confidentiality/data security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement sitting outside the cap; we can accept a straight 12 months' fees cap as a fallback.

ops.newText: EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED THE GREATER OF (A) THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID OR PAYABLE FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTHS PERIOD AND (B) USD 1,000,000, AND NEITHER PARTY SHALL BE LIABLE FOR ANY INDIRECT, CONSEQUENTIAL, SPECIAL OR PUNITIVE DAMAGES. "EXCLUDED CLAIMS" MEANS A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY, DATA PROTECTION OR SECURITY OBLIGATIONS, ITS INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS UNDER THIS SECTION 12, ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILLFUL MISCONDUCT OR FRAUD, AND ITS INFRINGEMENT OF THE OTHER PARTY'S INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS; CLIENT'S OBLIGATION TO PAY COMPENSATION DUE UNDER SECTION 5 IS NOT SUBJECT TO THIS LIMITATION.
